# Remember Forever

Remember Forever is a flashcard learning application for creating, reviewing, and measuring retained knowledge.

Public pages:
- [Product overview](https://remfo.app/)
- [Pricing](https://remfo.app/pricing)

Authenticated application pages:
- [Record](https://remfo.app/record) — create and manage flashcards
- [Learn](https://remfo.app/learn) — learn new material
- [Revise](https://remfo.app/revise) — review due flashcards
- [Measure](https://remfo.app/measure) — view learning progress
